messages:
Aditi (partnerships): Samsung sent a draft NDA + provisional Exynos AI v1 boards for our EAP. They want a short bench plan and an SI integration checklist by next Tue. Who can own the plan?
Samir (eng-runtime): I can take the runtime checklist and test harness. Need HW specs and PCIe / driver details from Samsung.
Ethan (eng-ml): I can own model benching (latency/throughput/quality). Which models do we want to prioritize? GPT-like and embedding models?
Lina (product): Prioritize 3 workloads: customer chat (chat-llm), embeddings for semantic search, and a reranker LR model. Also consider a 2-minute smoke test for Marketplace listing.
Aditi (partnerships): @Samir / @Ethan noted. Samsung contact (Jae) indicated 8 dev boards shipping next Wed. NDA needs countersign by Friday EOD. Also they asked for a non-public schedule for a joint announcement — ask legal about embargo. :eyes:
Raj (eng-sre): We'll need a stable testbed image with pinned driver + kernel. I can prepare infra and AMIs, plus a quickfail runbook. Tagging infra ops.
Ethan (eng-ml): Proposed bench commands (quick smoke):
```
./run_bench --model gpt-mini --batch 1 --seq 1024 --mode latency --hw exynos-v1
./run_bench --model embed-small --batch 64 --mode throughput --hw exynos-v1
```
Samir (eng-runtime): Good. We'll add KV cache warmup and continuous batching toggles. Also plan to test quantized kernels (int8) vs fp16. Need sample model artifacts.
Aditi (partnerships): Action items: 1) Samir runtime checklist + CI job (owner: Samir) 2) Ethan bench scripts + eval prompts (owner: Ethan) 3) Raj testbed image + runbook (owner: Raj) 4) Lina coordinate Marketplace smoke test + product requirements (owner: Lina) 5) Partnerships to finalize NDA countersign (owner: Aditi). Deadline: next Tue EOD.
PartnerBot: Reminder: Upload bench results to private feedback sheet: https://docs.example.com/samsung-eap (internal).
Lina (product): For the joint announcement ask: recommend soft embargo (no public PR) until we have 3 reproducible runs and partner approval. Would like a draft blog by 2025-10-10.
Ethan (eng-ml): I'll prepare evaluation prompts + golden set for quality regressions. Will also log model seeds and exact binary hashes.
Samir (eng-runtime): I'll add CI flags to run on both our CI and the Exynos testbed. If we see regressions, auto-roll to a fallback x86 flow.
Aditi (partnerships): Perfect. I'll send countersign request today and confirm shipping ETA. If anyone needs the NDA redline, ping me — I'll attach the PDF. :thumbsup:
Lina (product): Can someone add expected cost/hours estimate for the Marketplace smoke test? We need to fill the ops intake form.
Raj (eng-sre): Estimate ~24h infra setup + 8h smoke runs + 8h troubleshooting. Putting in the intake now.
Aditi (partnerships): Thanks all — will follow up in this thread once NDA signed and tracking sheet is live.
